clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind’s Dwarven District, Shoni the Shilent sends a crew beneath Westfall. She leads the gnomish effort to reclaim Gnomeregan and seeks power for the machines meant to break a path back into the city.

Shoni the Shilent directs a gnomish assault crew from Stormwind’s Dwarven District. With Gnomeregan held by troggs, she plans to retake the city and sends operatives into the tunnels beneath Westfall for the parts her crew needs.

Shoni’s plan depends on the gnomes’ gyrodrillmatic excavationators, heavy machines built to break through Gnomeregan’s underground borders and open a way for an assault. The machines lack power, so she seeks the intact Gnoam Sprecklesprocket from a working goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines. She also sends adventurers into Gnomeregan to dismantle its robots for spare parts to repair her fleet.
